_comment: Two trinket slots per hero. rarity: common / uncommon / rare / boss. price is used by the General Store. class: only that class can wear it. skill_mods: {move id: {dmg_pct, acc, crit, effect_chance, mark_rounds, dot, heal, heal_pct, move}} bonuses to one move.

lucky_horseshoe.name: Lucky Horseshoe
lucky_horseshoe.desc: Bent iron, nailed over a hundred doors.

silver_spurs.name: Silver Spurs
silver_spurs.desc: They jingle when you walk. Everybody hears you coming.

pocket_bible.name: Pocket Bible
pocket_bible.desc: Stopped a bullet once. Or so they say.

snakeskin_belt.name: Snakeskin Belt
snakeskin_belt.desc: Rattler hide, cured hard. Nothing gets through it easy.

wolf_tooth.name: Wolf-Tooth Necklace
wolf_tooth.desc: Taken from a wolf that picked the wrong camp.

salt_charm.name: Salt-Charm Pouch
salt_charm.desc: Old country wisdom for new country monsters.

tin_canteen.name: Dented Canteen
tin_canteen.desc: Always seems to have one more swallow.

iron_gorget.name: Iron Gorget
iron_gorget.desc: Old cavalry armor for the throat.

loaded_dice.name: Loaded Dice
loaded_dice.desc: They always come up sevens. Almost always.

crow_feather_charm.name: Blackwing Feather
crow_feather_charm.desc: Ruby wore it in her hat. The crows still nod at it.

stagecoach_ticket.name: Unused Stage Ticket
stagecoach_ticket.desc: A way home, never used. Yet.

wanderers_dollar.name: The Wanderer's Silver Dollar
wanderers_dollar.desc: Shot through the middle, at forty paces. "Keep it. You earned the hole."

cranes_revolver.name: Crane's Engraved Revolver
cranes_revolver.desc: Silas Crane's pride and joy. The grip still has his initials.

cyclops_eye_stone.name: Cyclops' Eye-Stone
cyclops_eye_stone.desc: A pupil-sized agate that never stops watching.

titan_shard.name: Shard of the Titan
titan_shard.desc: Warm to the touch, and very heavy.

bounty_ledger.name: Bounty Ledger
bounty_ledger.desc: Every name in it has a price, and a line through it when it's paid.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.desc: Keeps every edge keen, and the owner fussing over it.

dutch_courage.name: Flask of Dutch Courage
dutch_courage.desc: One swallow before the shooting starts.

last_letter.name: Last Letter Home
last_letter.desc: Written, sealed, never sent. Not yet.

tin_star.name: Tarnished Tin Star
tin_star.desc: Older than the Marshal, and it's stopped more than one bullet.

warrant_book.name: Bench Warrant Book
warrant_book.desc: Signed by a judge who doesn't ask questions.

bear_claw.name: Bear-Claw Necklace
bear_claw.desc: Took the claws off the bear that took the scars.

elk_bone.name: Elk-Bone Charm
elk_bone.desc: Carved by firelight, for luck in the old ways.

golden_spike.name: Golden Spike
golden_spike.desc: The last spike of the line. Swung, not driven.

union_pin.name: Union Pin
union_pin.desc: Pinned on in the strike of '77. Never taken off.

pearl_grips.name: Pearl-Handled Grips
pearl_grips.desc: Pretty to look at. Prettier to watch.

biscuit_collar.name: Biscuit's Studded Collar
biscuit_collar.desc: Brass studs and a name tag. Biscuit is very proud of it.

rawhide_riata.name: Braided Rawhide Riata
rawhide_riata.desc: Sixty feet of it, braided by hand over a whole winter.

marked_deck.name: Marked Deck
marked_deck.desc: Every card known by its back.

silver_dollar.name: Lucky Silver Dollar
silver_dollar.desc: Heads, they win. Tails, they flip again.

blasting_caps.name: Tin of Blasting Caps
blasting_caps.desc: Rattles in the pocket. Everyone keeps their distance.

assayers_loupe.name: Assayer's Loupe
assayers_loupe.desc: Tells fool's gold from the real thing at a glance.

gator_darts.name: Gator-Tooth Dart Case
gator_darts.desc: The darts are tipped with something nastier than gator.

gris_gris.name: Gris-Gris Bag
gris_gris.desc: Bones, herbs and a bit of swamp. It hums when they're sick.

surgical_kit.name: Silver Surgical Kit
surgical_kit.desc: Fine instruments from back East. The only clean things for a hundred miles.

ether_bottle.name: Ether Bottle
ether_bottle.desc: Sweet-smelling and very much not a drink.

family_hymnal.name: Family Hymnal
family_hymnal.desc: Every family who ever owned it wrote their names in the front.

holy_water.name: Holy Water
holy_water.desc: Drawn from the river at a baptism. The unnatural flinch at it.

brakemans_lantern.name: Brakeman's Lantern
brakemans_lantern.desc: Swung from the last car, it signals the train to roll.

pocket_watch.name: Conductor's Pocket Watch
pocket_watch.desc: Set to railroad time. She's never late for a train.
